original: - Welcome to the Goodsprings Coffee House -
- Welcome to the Goodsprings Coffee House -

It's been 3 weeks since leaving the caravan to forge my own path, my own adventures and ofcourse, my own caps!

What a place this is though huh? who would of thought there would have been such a goldmine of supplies, weapons and fortification in the old coffee house? It's pretty dark here - but hey, maybe thats for the best - I wouldn't want to draw attention to myself and my treasures here. Feel like i've won the damn lottery...

I rekon i'd survive atleast a couple of years off the rations in the back room alone if I eat with a little disipline! Those damn raiders are probably still looking for me. I shouldn't have tried to steal from them but that pack of stimpacks was too valuable. 

Those kind looking settlers in... (what was it? Goodsprings I think the sign said) might even be with them - didn't look like the type, but still. In vegas you can't be to careful. Maybe in a week or two i'll introduce myself - might even be able to swing some friendly trade.

Anyway, need to think of a trader name!
translation:
离开商队后，我踏上了自己的道路，开始自己的冒险，当然还有自己的旅程，已经三周了！

这真是个神奇的地方，对吧？谁能想到，这家老咖啡屋里竟然藏有如此丰富的物资、武器和防御设施？这里很暗，不过也许这样最好，我可不想让自己和这里的宝贝过于张扬。天，在这里，感觉就像中了头奖一样...

我想，如果我控制一下饮食，至少能在后室靠口粮撑上几年！妈的，那些掠夺者可能还在找我。我不该试图从他们那里偷东西的，但那包治疗针实在太珍贵了。 

那些看起来和蔼的定居者们......（那是什么地方来着？我记得牌子上是写清泉镇）甚至可能跟掠夺者是一伙的！虽然看起来不像，但也不能排除这种可能性。在新维加斯，你不得不小心谨慎。也许一两个星期后，我会去自我介绍，可能还会促成一些友好的交易。

不管怎样，该想个公司名字了！

original:
Its been about a week in my dark little coffee house, rations are  looking just as healthy as last week. I swear I heard something outside this afternoon - maybe a local? 

Anyway... I cleaned up the place a little. It's remarkably well preserved anyway - but il'l need to be a little more careful, I still need to lay low - atleast a little longer. 

I've boarded up the crack I broke in through also. I doubt you could tell anyone came in through the back. Mission accomplished!

FYI: From this afternoon - i'll only move during the night. Dont wan't to draw attention to myself. Atleast its dark and warm here. 

I should probably grab something to eat about now. Im going to make an effort to write these logs weekly - seems dreadfully ritualistic I know but it might just keep me from going mad from all the isolation.

Feeling pretty positive about my prospects here in goodsprings. Wonder if anyone's ever going to read this. Sigining off week two.
translation:
我在这间昏暗的咖啡小屋里待了大约一周，食物储备看起来和上周一样充足。我发誓，今天下午我听到外面有动静，可能是个本地人？ 

不管怎样......我把这里打扫了一下。虽然这里保存得相当完好，但我得更加小心，我仍然需要低调行事，至少再低调一段时间。 

我也把我钻进来的那个裂缝用木板封住了。我想你应该看不出有人是从后面进来的。任务完成！

仅供参考：从今天下午开始，我只会在晚上行动。我不想引起别人的注意。至少这里又黑又暖和。 

我现在可能得吃点东西了。我打算每周写一次日志，我知道这听起来很仪式化，但也许能让我在隔离期间不至于发疯。

我对在清泉镇的前景感到相当乐观。不知道会不会有人读到这封信？第二周结束。

original:
Week 3, came across a hell of load of gun parts, in the vent through in the cafe area; good parts too. Might try repair a couple of them. Found a fantastic looking book on repair in one of the cash drawers - might even try my hand at it this week. If I could get them working they'd fetch a hell of a load of caps, just the kick upwards for the "Jumpstart Trading Company"

Oh I guess I have'nt mentioned it! But I settled on the name for my new caravan: 

The "Jumpstart Trading Company" great isn't it. If my luck keeps up,  I'll have an empire by november.

Im getting off track! but those gun parts - that's not even the best find this week. Behind all the gun parts in that that vent I mentioned... Coffee. I know Coffee in a damn Coffee Shop. It's some damn good coffee too, a little damp - but as far as vegas goes it's scotch. Fine nectar of a bygone era.

Locals seem to be getting a lot more inquisitve of the place lately, I think one of them had a bit too much to drink and tried kicking in the door the other night. It's fine im going to approach them in a weeks time - I promise.

Im going to have to be even more careful until then, I need to have a foothold on this place before attempting trade. If I can set up just a little more i'll be able to open this place up again - like the pre-war days i'd imagine.

Damn, that coffee is good.
translation:
第三周，在咖啡区的通风口里，我偶然发现了一大堆枪械零件，其中不乏优质零件，我可能会试着修几件。在其中一个收银抽屉里，我还发现了一本看起来很棒的维修书，这周我甚至可能会试着动手修一修。如果我能把它们修好，它们就能换来一大笔瓶盖，光是“跃迁贸易公司”的启动资金就足够了。

哦，我想我还没提到过！不过我已经为我的新商队选好了名字：

“跃迁贸易公司”真的很棒，不是吗？如果我的运气能一直这么好的话，到11月我就能拥有一个商业帝国了。

我跑题了！但那些枪支零件，这甚至不是本周发现的最好宝贝。在我提到的那个通风口里，除了那些枪支零件，还有......咖啡。我知道，那是一家该死的咖啡屋里的咖啡。那咖啡真不错，虽然有点潮湿，但就新维加斯而言，那已经是苏格兰威士忌级别的了。那是逝去时代的美好甘露。

最近，当地人似乎对这个地方越来越好奇了。我想，其中一个人可能是喝多了，他前几天晚上还试图踢门而入。不过没关系，我保证，我会在一周后主动去找他们。

在那之前，我必须更加小心谨慎。在尝试进行贸易之前，我必须在这个地方站稳脚跟。如果我能再稍微建立一些基础，我就能再次开放这个地方，就像战前的日子一样，我想。

该死，这咖啡真好喝。

original:
Drank more coffee than water this week. Turns out Im a lot better at making dioramas with guns than I am at actually fixing them, I doubt any of these would actually fire.

I took a bunch of top quality parts and made fucking toys out of them. God I feel worked up today. Only thing that would even consider firing a bullet is likely the shotgun under the bar - and it was there when I broke in.

Heard a group of folks outside lastnight and saw flickers of light in the windows. I swear to god if they even think of touchiing my fucking coffee.

I don't feel much like trading with the locals anymore - they seem off to me, always snooping around my den. I'm locking the staff room door.

I seem to have developed this odd twitch and I can't stop shaking. Maybe it's the lack of sunlight. But It would seem im not as healthy as I thought I was.

Anyway did you know coffee packets make for some fine reading material? I wonder what Epinephrine is anyway? Word of the day Epinephrine. I fucking hate the locals.
translation:
这周我喝的咖啡比水还多。我还发现，比起真正修理枪支，我更擅长用枪制作模型，我怀疑这些模型根本不能真的开火。

我拿了一大堆优质零件，用它们做了些该死的玩具。天哪，我今天真是火大。唯一能考虑开枪的，可能就是吧台下的那把霰弹枪，我闯进来的时候它就在那儿。

昨晚听到外面有一群人，还看到窗户里透出微光。我发誓，要是他们敢他妈的动我的咖啡，我就跟他们拼了。

我不想再和当地人做交易了，他们让我很不舒服，总是偷偷地在我窝点附近转悠。我要把员工室的门锁上。

我似乎患上了这种奇怪的抽搐症，而且我无法停止颤抖。也许是因为缺乏阳光。但看来我并不像自己想象的那么健康。

话说，你知道咖啡包装纸也可以做成不错的阅读材料吗？我倒想知道肾上腺素到底是什么？今日一词：肾上腺素。我恨本地人。

original:
I refuse. I can see from the window, those FUCKING locals... I bet they know, they know I have the coffee probably some of the best in the mojave - they want it but they couldn't even appreciate it's beauty. God I can't stop fucking drinking it, i've never felt so alive. The legion, the NCR, Raiders, Mercs I feel like I could take you all with my bare hands. Screw all of you.
 
Im going to load the shotgun by the bar with a few rounds, I have a feeling they will come, come for my precious coffee. I'll be ready. Im going to move out of the staff room and wait by the bar, I'll return here to write important updates but otherwise I need to guard the coffee. I've moved all the coffee I retreived back into the vent I found it in.

I'll defend it - not a single bean will fall into the hands of these wolves.
translation:
我拒绝。我从窗户看到了那些该死的当地人......我敢打赌他们知道，他们知道我这里的咖啡可能是莫哈韦最好的，他们想要，哪怕他们甚至无法欣赏它的美妙。天哪，我简直停不下来，我从未感到如此充满活力。军团、NCR、掠夺者、雇佣兵，我觉得我徒手就能对付你们所有人。去你们的。

我打算在吧台旁给霰弹枪装上几发子弹，我有种预感，他们会来，来抢我珍贵的咖啡。我会做好准备。我要搬出员工休息室，在吧台旁等着，我会回到这里来写重要的更新，但除此之外，我需要守住咖啡。我已经把所有取回的咖啡都放回我发现它们的通风口了。

我会保护它，一粒豆子也不会落入这些饿狼的手中。

original:
SHIT SHIT SHIT. The lightswitch. By the door. I must've bumped it while I was looking out of the window. Coffee. Place lit up like a fucking. Coffee. Christmas tree.

I'm sure to draw attention now. When they come. I'll slaughter them all and bury their bodies. I spied a graveyard at the top of the hill by the the settlement. No going back now.

Coffee. Coffee. Coffee....
translation:
该死，该死，该死。是门边的电灯开关。我肯定是往窗外看的时候碰到了它。咖啡。这地方亮得跟他妈的咖啡馆一样。咖啡。圣诞树。

现在这里肯定会引人注意。等他们来的时候，我会把他们全都杀了，并把他们的尸体都埋掉。我在房子旁边的山顶上发现了一片墓地。现在可不能回头了。

original:
Three, three of them. Three of those damn nosey rat locals came by tonight. Got two of them with the same shot. The third one put up more of a fight, had to end him with the butt of the shotgun.

I'm sorry. So sorry. why did they have to come near me? near me and MY Coffee. Coffee My coffee. Sorry. So Sorry.

Graveyard was too far to go without drawing suspicion. Had to bury them in the back. 

Coffee. Im going. leave. soon. must bury bodies. So tired. I should drink some more coffee.
translation:
三个，他们三个。今晚有三个该死的爱管闲事的当地人过来。我用同一枪击中了其中两个。第三个反抗得厉害些，最后不得不用霰弹枪挥击才把他打倒。

对不起。真的很抱歉。他们为什么要靠近我？靠近我和我的咖啡。咖啡，我的咖啡。对不起。真的很抱歉。

墓地离得太远，去的话会引起怀疑。得把他们埋在后面。 

咖啡。我要走了。很快。必须埋葬尸体。好累。我应该再喝些咖啡。

original:
~DELIVERY NOTE~

Scotch x10
Nuka-Cola x13
Vault-Tec Branded Coffee x23 (I don't remember ordering this? some promotion?)
Replacement Mugs x 20
Beer [Barrel] x3
Beer [Bottle] x15

I arrived here a few weeks ago with ambitious goals of trading with the locals and starting a new business on the new vegas frontier.

Instead I've ended up with three dead bodies and what feels like the worst hangover imaginable.

Im so damn sorry. I dont remember much... and I know this is going to sound odd,  but i think it was the coffee.

Anyway. whoever finds this. The place is yours. It's well equipped and I've tidied the place up a fair bit.

I've hidden the remaining coffee... please don't seek it out. Or even drink it.

Im sorry. so sorry. I never should have left the caravan.
translation:
几周前，我带着与当地人贸易和在新维加斯边境拓展业务的雄心壮志来到了这里。

结果我在这里只留下了三具尸体，还经历了十分难以想象的宿醉。

我真的很抱歉。很多事都记不得了......我知道这听起来可能很奇怪，但我觉得这跟咖啡有关。

不管怎样，无论谁发现这个地方，它都是你的了。这里设备齐全，而且我已经把这里收拾得相当干净了。

我把剩下的咖啡藏起来了......请不要去找它，甚至是喝它。

对不起，真的对不起。我不该离开商队的。
